# Location scope (display only): the stored years of the Stored Food step the province carries (its whole months
# / 12; pp_food_store_step holds the step + 100). 0 without one.
pp_stored_food_years = {
	value = 0
	province ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_food_store_step var:pp_food_store_step > 99.5 }
			add = var:pp_food_store_step
			subtract = 100
		}
	}
	divide = 12
	min = 0
}

# Location scope (display only): the years the carried step is short of / above the pivot, the sizes its store-lever
# lines (Low Stores / Full Stores) are applied at. 0 without a step.
pp_stored_food_low_years = {
	value = 0
	province ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_food_store_step var:pp_food_store_step > 99.5 }
			add = 112.0
			subtract = var:pp_food_store_step
		}
	}
	divide = 12
	min = 0
}
pp_stored_food_full_years = {
	value = 0
	province ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_food_store_step var:pp_food_store_step > 99.5 }
			add = var:pp_food_store_step
			subtract = 112.0
		}
	}
	divide = 12
	min = 0
}

# Location scope (display only): yearly population growth from the province's Stored Food step, its local_population_growth.
# It is part of modifier:local_population_growth; the engine adds no storage term of its own.
pp_province_food_storage_growth = {
	value = pp_stored_food_years
	multiply = 0.006
}
